triggers: transposed staging produces wrong numerics or partial zero fragments on Metal 4 toolchains

payload.goal: Do not rely on the transpose flag of simdgroup_load; verify fragment-layout semantics empirically.

problem.statement: The transpose_matrix flag of simdgroup_load in the metal4.0 toolchain (metalfe-32023.921.6) applies stride semantics that do not match the documented row-major intuition: a probe kernel loading a known 8x8 tile returned partially-populated fragments.

payload.technique: avoid simdgroup_load transpose=true; verify fragment layout with a collective probe
payload.what: Writing a transposed-staging kernel that then loads A fragments with transpose_matrix=true.
payload.when: When fragment layout must be transposed, stage into the layout the identity load expects instead, or validate first with a 10-line probe kernel: fill a known tile, load with the candidate flags, store out, compare. The probe itself must run simdgroup ops unconditionally across all 32 threads.
how: the same flag may behave differently across Metal toolchain versions; re-probe on upgrade

raw.seed: onyx-infer kernel-agent/q4-mma episode, ABBA-measured on Apple M5 Max (Mac17,14, Metal 4, metalfe-32023.921.6), 2026-11-17
